pairs: Igitur profecta omnis multitudo filiorum Israël de deserto Sin per mansiones suas,
And so, the entire multitude of the sons of Israel, having set out from the desert of Sin in stages,
juxta sermonem Domini, castrametati sunt in Raphidim,
according to the word of the Lord, made camp at Rephidim,
ubi non erat aqua ad bibendum populo.
where there was no water for the people to drink.
For what reason do you tempt the Lord?”
Sitivit ergo ibi populus præ aquæ penuria,
And so the people were thirsty in that place, due to the scarcity of water,
Cur fecisti nos exire de Ægypto,
“Why did you cause us to go out of Egypt,
ut occideres nos, et liberos nostros,
so as to kill us and our children, as well as our cattle,
Then Moses cried out to the Lord,
“What shall I do with this people?
And the Lord said to Moses:
et sume tecum de senioribus Israël:
and take with you some of the elders of Israel.
And take in your hand the staff,
with which you struck the river,
En ego stabo ibi coram te,
Lo, I will stand in that place before you,
And you shall strike the rock,
and water will go forth from it,
so that the people may drink.”
Fecit Moyses ita coram senioribus Israël:
Moses did so in the sight of the elders of Israel.
et vocavit nomen loci illius, Tentatio,
And he called the name of that place ‘Temptation,’
because of the arguing of the sons of Israel,
and because they tempted the Lord,
et pugnabat contra Israël in Raphidim.
and fought against Israel at Rephidim.
“Choose men. And when you go out,
cras ego stabo in vertice collis,
Tomorrow, I will stand at the top of the hill,
habens virgam Dei in manu mea.
holding the staff of God in my hand.”
Fecit Josue ut locutus erat Moyses,
Joshua did as Moses had spoken,
Moyses autem et Aaron et Hur ascenderunt super verticem collis.
But Moses and Aaron and Hur ascended to the top of the hill.
And when Moses lifted up his hands,
But when he released them a little while,
Then the hands of Moses became heavy.
et Hur sustentabant manus ejus ex utraque parte.
Then Aaron and Hur sustained his hands from both sides.
Et factum est ut manus illius non lassarentur usque ad occasum solis.
And it happened that his hands did not tire until the setting of the sun.
And Joshua put to flight Amalek
et populum ejus in ore gladii.
and his people by the edge of the sword.
Then the Lord said to Moses: “Write this,
Scribe hoc ob monimentum in libro, et trade auribus Josue:
as a memorial in a book, and deliver it to the ears of Joshua.
delebo enim memoriam Amalec sub cælo.
For I will wipe away the memory of Amalek from under heaven.”
“The hand of the throne of the Lord,
et bellum Domini erit contra Amalec,
and the war of the Lord,
will be against Amalek from generation to generation.”
